description: Hospital-style benchmark scorecard metrics mapped to public evidence layers. These rows start from the HSHS balanced scorecard categories shown by the user and are intended to bridge management targets with public audit evidence.

records.source: User-provided hospital balanced scorecard screenshot; public-data bridge built in dashboard
records.limitations: The screenshot gives benchmark categories and example target structure, not audited Taylorville-specific performance values. Public data can approximate or contextualize some categories, but cannot replace internal scorecard reporting.

metrics.publicProxy: Careers pages, job-opening counts, role categories, staffing ratings where available
metrics.appEvidence: Facility careers observations and role mix
metrics.auditUse: Use public hiring demand as operating context, not as proof of turnover.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS/IDPH infection and hospital safety measures where available
metrics.auditUse: Connect infection signals to HAC/POA and payment-risk validation.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS hospital infection measures and HAC context
metrics.auditUse: Compare infection direction against readmission, safety, LOS, and HAC risk.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS hospital infection measures and HAC context
metrics.auditUse: Tie infection prevention outcomes to reimbursement-risk questions.

metrics.publicProxy: HCAHPS recommend hospital and patient experience measures
metrics.auditUse: Frame reputation/access context, not direct reimbursement proof.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS safety measures, HAC measures, survey/penalty data where available
metrics.auditUse: Ask whether safety risk overlaps with denials, HAC/POA exposure, or avoidable LOS.
Use as severity/quality context before making payment-performance claims.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS readmission measures and readmission penalty data
metrics.auditUse: Connect readmission signal to avoidable utilization and payment-penalty risk.

metrics.appEvidence: DRG/APR-DRG, CC/MCC, LOS, and documentation scenario bridge
metrics.auditUse: Treat as internal revenue-cycle/documentation performance that public data can only explain conceptually.

metrics.publicProxy: Cost-report days/discharges, public payer enrollment context, Hospital Report Card volume fields where available
metrics.appEvidence: HCRIS utilization and HFS enrollment context
metrics.auditUse: Bridge population context to patient volume and access pressure.

metrics.appEvidence: CMS HCRIS total discharges and inpatient days
metrics.auditUse: Compare volume against cost, revenue, occupancy, and CAH access role.

metrics.publicProxy: Price transparency surgery CPT rows and cost-report outpatient charge mix
metrics.auditUse: Needs service-line data; public price rows prove posted prices, not surgery volume.

metrics.publicProxy: HCRIS outpatient revenue/charges and outpatient service examples
metrics.appEvidence: HCRIS outpatient charges and price transparency outpatient rows
metrics.auditUse: Understand outpatient dependence and EAPG/OPPS relevance.

metrics.publicProxy: HFS provider payment ER recipients/costs and price transparency ED rows
metrics.appEvidence: HFS provider-level ER service recipients and ED scenario bridge
metrics.auditUse: Connect ED access to discharged-home, observation, admission, and transfer pathways.

metrics.publicProxy: Public data is limited; possible Hospital Report Card or provider-level payment context
metrics.appEvidence: HFS provider payments and workforce demand
metrics.auditUse: Flag as a future outpatient-access importer need.

metrics.publicProxy: No direct public proxy; CPT/HCPCS volume/payment files may approximate some activity
metrics.appEvidence: Future Medicare utilization/payment files and fee schedules
metrics.auditUse: Keep separate from hospital facility reimbursement; wRVU is professional productivity.

metrics.publicProxy: CMS HCRIS operating margin, audited statements, Form 990, bond disclosures
metrics.auditUse: Compare facility-reported margin to system-level margin while keeping CCN and system evidence separate.

metrics.publicProxy: HCRIS net income from service to patients; audited statements may separate unusual items
metrics.appEvidence: Taylorville HCRIS net income from service to patients
metrics.auditUse: Use as an operating-performance bridge, but do not assume FEMA or one-time items are isolated in public files.
